meta.title: Implement streaming uploads and tool formatting
meta.body_summary: Add streaming file uploads/downloads to reduce memory usage and extend tool formatting to system, integration, and API call tools.

perf_labels.notes: Codex PR with streaming and tool formatting; closed after 53 days; CI typecheck failed due to undefined name in test; no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 181 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit. As a mixed performance/feature enhancement PR, it was closed without merge, likely due to inactivity and unresolved CI failure.

review_details.concern_detail: The test file test_file_streaming.py uses undefined name 's3_client' at line 10, causing a pytype failure. Bots also suggested code improvements (async removal, import placement). No benchmark or performance evidence provided.
review_details.performance_claim: Streaming file uploads/downloads and listing reduces memory usage; tool formatting supports more types.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after 53 days with unresolved CI typecheck failure; no human engagement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementation required async IO, S3 streaming, and dynamic tool schema generation; agent code had test correctness issues that were not addressed.

detection_detail.ci_auto: pytype CI job detected undefined name 's3_client' in test_file_streaming.py, causing check failure.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or measurable evidence; only narrative claim of reduced memory usage.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: CI failure not fixed; PR converted to draft and later closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added streaming file upload (chunked base64 decoding) and download (streaming S3 read and base64 encoding), prepared streaming file listing, and extended format_tool to handle system, integration, and api_call tools.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: List files change is minor; test files validate functionality but contained a name error.
change_trajectory: Single commit with all changes. CI typecheck failed due to undefined 's3_client'. No further activity; PR closed after 53 days.
